transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on for about two years and three months, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy, low mood.
Have you had any period of at least two months during these past two years when your mood felt normal or back to your usual self?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling normal like that at all. This low mood has been completely continuous and constant for the entire two years and three months without any real break. It just hasn't lifted even for a little while.
